facts.activity_file: replacing seals and seal support fluid
facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: trapped hazardous energy found after isolation of P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-3222 and M-3222 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 5 December 2021 a potential incident was recorded on P-3222 and M-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
